D.name: D* — Deuteronomy, old layer (GTC from paper)
D.notes: The paper's D corpus (Table S1): the old layer of Deuteronomy, following Preuss. Deut 6, 12–13, 15–16, 18–19, 26, 28.

DtrH.name: DtrH* — Deuteronomistic History (GTC from paper)
DtrH.notes: The paper's DtrH corpus (Table S1): passages the authors take as Deuteronomistic compositions in Deuteronomy to Kings. Deut 8–11, 27; Josh 1, 5, 6, 12, 23; Judg 2, 6; 2 Sam 7; 1 Kgs 8; 2 Kgs 17:1–21, 22–25.

P.name: P* — Priestly (GTC from paper)
P.notes: The paper's P corpus (Table S1), following Nihan for the end of Pg: Gen 17; Exod 6, 16, 25–31, 35–40; Lev 1–4, 8–9, plus P auxiliary narration as a reference-only unit. The preprint lists Gen 1 where Table S1 has Lev 4; we follow Table S1.

DD.name: D** — D* + DtrH*, reduced
DD.notes: D* and DtrH* combined, without Deut 28, Josh 6, 1 Kgs 8 and Judg 6. Reference pair with P* for the HC discrepancy test. Excluded as poor or doubtful examples of the source: Deut 28; Josh 6 (Joshua is widely seen as containing priestly or post-P material); 1 Kgs 8 (DtrH classification not a consensus; rejected by every corpus); Judg 6 (probably redacted from an older Gideon source).

DIntro.name: Deuteronomy intro (Deut 1–11)
DIntro.notes: The introductory speeches of Deuteronomy, chapters 1–11. Deut 8–11 are also DtrH* chapters.

DLaw.name: Deuteronomic Law Code (Deut 12–26)
DLaw.notes: The law code of Deuteronomy, chapters 12–26. Several chapters are also D* chapters.

Lev.name: Leviticus (entire book)
Lev.notes: All of Leviticus, including the Holiness Code (Lev 17–26). Lev 12 is reference-only because it has under 250 tokens.

ExNar.name: Exodus story (Exod 1–14)
ExNar.notes: Exodus 1–14 without chapter 6, which is a P* chapter. Contains some priestly material (for example in Exod 12).
